arxiv-1912-11484.title: Some properties of Sadik transform and its applications of fractional-order dynamical systems in control theory
arxiv-1912-11484.creator: Saleh S. Redhwan Department of MathematicsDr.Babasaheb Ambedkar MarathwadaUniversity, Aurangabad, (M.S),431001, India saleh.redhwan909@gmail.com Sadikali L. ShaikhDepartment of MathematicsMaulana Azad College of arts,Science and CommerceAurangabad, (M.S),431001, India, Mohammed S. Abdo
arxiv-1912-11484.description: Abstract In this paper, we study some new properties of Sadik transform such as integration, time delay, initial value theorem, and final value theorem. Moreover, we prove the theorem of Sadik transform for Caputo fractional derivative and we also establish sufficient conditions for the existence of the Sadik transform of Caputo fractional derivatives.

arxiv-2110-11292.title: OpenABC-D: A Large-Scale Dataset For Machine Learning Guided Integrated Circuit Synthesis
arxiv-2110-11292.creator: Animesh Basak Chowdhury, Benjamin Tan, Ramesh Karri, Siddharth Garg
arxiv-2110-11292.description: Abstract Logic synthesis is a challenging and widely-researched combinatorial optimization problem during integrated circuit (IC) design. It transforms a high-level description of hardware in a programming language like Verilog into an optimized digital circuit netlist, a network of interconnected Boolean logic gates, that implements the function.

arxiv-2310-09888.title: A mirror theorem for non-split toric bundles
arxiv-2310-09888.creator: Yuki Koto
arxiv-2310-09888.description: Abstract . We construct an I I -function for toric bundles obtained as a fiberwise GIT quotient of a (not necessarily split) vector bundle. This is a generalization of Brown’s I I -function for split toric bundles [ 5 ] and the I I -function for non-split projective bundles [ 21 ] .

arxiv-2312-00179.title: Duality between the Maxwell-Chern-Simons and self-dual models in very special relativity
arxiv-2312-00179.creator: Fernando M. Belchior, Roberto V. Maluf
arxiv-2312-00179.description: Abstract This work aims to investigate the classical-level duality between the S ​ I ​ M ​ ( 1 ) SIM(1) -Maxwell-Chern-Simons (MCS) model and its self-dual counterpart. Initially, our focus is on free-field cases to establish equivalence through two distinct approaches: comparing the equations of motion and utilizing the master Lagrangian method.

arxiv-2506-22963.title: CN-SBM: Categorical Block Modelling For Primary and Residual Copy Number Variation
arxiv-2506-22963.creator: Kevin Lam, William Daniels, J Maxwell Douglas, Daniel Lai, Samuel Aparicio, Benjamin Bloem-Reddy, Yongjin Park
arxiv-2506-22963.description: Abstract Cancer is a genetic disorder whose clonal evolution can be monitored by tracking noisy genome-wide copy number variants. We introduce the Copy Number Stochastic Block Model (CN-SBM), a probabilistic framework that jointly clusters samples and genomic regions based on discrete copy number states using a bipartite categorical block model.

arxiv-2507-07682.title: Prompt Engineering for Requirements Engineering: A Literature Review and Roadmap
arxiv-2507-07682.creator: Kaicheng Huang 1 , Fanyu Wang 1 , Yutan Huang 1 Chetan Arora 1
arxiv-2507-07682.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kaicheng Huang 1 , Fanyu Wang 1 , Yutan Huang 1 Chetan Arora 1. Advancements in large language models (LLMs) have led to a surge of prompt engineering (PE) techniques that can enhance various requirements engineering (RE) tasks. However, current LLMs are often characterized by significant uncertainty and a lack of controllability. This absence of clear guidance on how to effectively prompt LLMs acts as a barrier to their trustworthy implementation in the RE field.

arxiv-2510-19854.title: Multi-Resolution Analysis of the Convective Structure of Tropical Cyclones for Short-Term Intensity Guidance
arxiv-2510-19854.creator: Elizabeth Cucuzzella, Tria McNeely, Kimberly Wood, Ann B. Lee
arxiv-2510-19854.description: Abstract Accurate tropical cyclone (TC) short-term intensity forecasting with a 24-hour lead time is essential for disaster mitigation in the Atlantic TC basin. Since most TCs evolve far from land-based observing networks, satellite imagery is critical to monitoring these storms; however, these complex and high-resolution spatial structures can be challenging to qualitatively interpret in real time by forecasters.

arxiv-2601-06266.title: Self-Admitted Technical Debt in LLM Software: An Empirical Comparison with ML and Non-ML Software
arxiv-2601-06266.creator: Niruthiha Selvanayagam, Taher A. Ghaleb, Manel Abdellatif
arxiv-2601-06266.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Niruthiha Selvanayagam, Taher A. Ghaleb, Manel Abdellatif. Self-admitted technical debt (SATD), referring to comments in which developers explicitly acknowledge suboptimal code or incomplete functionality, has received extensive attention in machine learning (ML) and traditional (Non-ML) software. However, little is known about how SATD manifests and evolves in contemporary Large Language Model (LLM)-based systems, whose architectures, workflows, and dependencies differ fundamentally from both traditional and pre-LLM ML software.

arxiv-2602-16848.title: Predicting Generalized Steady States in Aperiodically Forced Mechanical Systems
arxiv-2602-16848.creator: Roshan S. Kaundinya 1 , Isabella Thiel 2 , Bálint Kaszás 3 , Shobhit Jain 4 and George Haller 1 1 Institute for Mechanical Systems, ETH Zürich 2 SAND Lab, MIT 3 Center for Turbulence Research, Stanford University 4 TU Delft
arxiv-2602-16848.description: Abstract The existence of generalized steady states (GSSs) in nonlinear mechanical systems under moderate temporally aperiodic forcing has only been shown recently. Here we derive systematic expansions for such GSSs and construct a numerical algorithm that yields explicit and arbitrarily refinable approximations for GSSs without the need for an initial convergence period.

pmc-10572405.title: Assessment of Functional Properties of Wheat–Cassava Composite Flour
pmc-10572405.creator: Mingjuan Li, Yayuan Zhang, Xiangrong You, Ying Wang, Kui Zhou, Ping Wei, Linyan Wei
pmc-10572405.description: Cassava flour (CF) was used as a raw material to replace wheat flour (WF) at levels of 0% (control), 10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, and 50% to prepare wheat–cassava composite flour (W-CF) and dough. The effects of different CF substituting levels on the functional properties of the W-CF and dough were investigated.

pmc-10600092.title: CT and MR imaging of primary biliary cholangitis: a pictorial review
pmc-10600092.creator: Yun Zhang, Tianying Zheng, Zixing Huang, Bin Song
pmc-10600092.description: Primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) is a rare chronic autoimmune-mediated cholestatic liver disease involving medium and small bile ducts that can lead to liver fibrosis and cirrhosis. To date, the pathogenesis of PBC remains elusive, and there is currently no curative medical treatment.

pmc-11324786.title: Detecting life by behavior, the overlooked sensitivity of behavioral assays
pmc-11324786.creator: Daniela Zinßmeister, Moshe Leibovitch, Eviatar Natan, Sondra Turjeman, Omry Koren, Michael Travisano, Yoni Vortman, Beatriz Baselga-Cervera
pmc-11324786.description: Detecting life has driven research and exploration for centuries, but recent attempts to compile and generate a framework that summarizes life features, aimed to develop strategies for life detection missions beyond planet Earth, have disregarded a key life feature: behavior. Yet, some behaviors such as biomineralization or motility have occasionally been proposed as biosignatures to detect life.

pmc-11422745.title: Digital Gamification Tool (Let’s Control Flu) to Increase Vaccination Coverage Rates: Proposal for Algorithm Development
pmc-11422745.creator: Henrique Lopes, Ricardo Baptista-Leite, Catarina Hermenegildo, Rifat Atun, Simone Ma, Alison McCallum, Byron Bunt
pmc-11422745.description: BackgroundInfluenza represents a critical public health challenge, disproportionately affecting at-risk populations, including older adults and those with chronic conditions, often compounded by socioeconomic factors. Innovative strategies, such as gamification, are essential for augmenting risk communication and community engagement efforts to address this threat.

Decisional conflict can affect psychological well-being and may reduce treatment adherence.
